DRAG DROP -
Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must monitor the Ethernet port and the corresponding VLAN traffic for the hyper4 device. The SW3 device is a Cisco Nexus 7000 Series switch. Drag and drop the code snippets from the right into the boxes in the configuration to meet these requirements.
context: Topology: SW3 -- Eth1/2 -- Monitoring Device. SW3 -- Eth1/4 (single downlink trunk) -- fans out to SW1 (local port Eth1/4, hosts Vlan51/hyper1, Vlan58/hyper2) and SW2 (local port Eth1/5, hosts Vlan52/hyper3, Vlan57/hyper4).
imageNote: Diagram: SW3 connects via Eth1/2 to a Monitoring Device and via Eth1/4 down to SW1 (Eth1/4) and SW2 (Eth1/5). SW1 hosts Vlan51/hyper1 and Vlan58/hyper2; SW2 hosts Vlan52/hyper3 and Vlan57/hyper4.
